description_sq:
Ne Yzberisht prane Vodafonit, shitet apartament 2+1+2 me planimetri te mire. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 banim te nje pallati te mireadministruar dhe orgnizohet ne nje sallon ndenje se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale, nje dhome gjumi femijesh dhe 2 tualete. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje zone e zhvilluar dhe shume e pershtatshme per banim pasi ploteson te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode. 
Per me teper informacion ose nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e telefonit.
description_en: In Yzberisht, near Vodafone, a 2+1+2 apartment with a good floor plan is for sale. The apartment is located on the 4th residential floor of a well-managed building and is organized in a living room together with a kitchen, a matrimonial bedroom, a children's bedroom and 2 toilets. The area in which the apartment is located is a developed area and very suitable for living as it provides all the necessary services for a comfortable life. For more information or a visit to the property, contact the phone number.
